what_happened: A bespoke one-off Python relative-link resolver plus the existing lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh baseline run surfaced a systemic docs-README.md/README.md naming mismatch (13 broken breadcrumb links across 7 files) and a second duplication instance (Three-Layer Architecture explanation, not named in the dispatch) quickly, without needing to read every file at full depth.

Planning re-derivation found three defect sites the research report's enumeration missed: orchestrate-state-machine.md:239 presents /implement {N} as a runnable resume command inside 420's cycle-budget paragraph; orchestrate-state-machine.md:948-955 and :1393-1397 carry record-versioning prose ('used to', 'is retired', 'unchanged from before this design existed'); copy-claude-directory.md has 3 (not 2) ../commands/README.md occurrences. Also found that the record-versioning forbidden vocabulary occurs ~56 times corpus-wide, ~53 of them inside the three boundary-owned architecture files, which forces an explicit scope narrowing in the plan.

The research report's per-site classification (dead-surface vs phase-name vs path-literal vs boundary) held up under spot-check on every site verified, including the subtle docs-README.md case where ../README.md correctly resolves to core/README.md and must NOT be swept by the 13-occurrence breadcrumb fix. That saved a full reclassification pass at planning time.

Phase 1 resolver found a second broken link on guides/user-installation.md:3 (../../../docs/installation/README.md) not enumerated by the research report's 21-site list or the plan. In scope; added to Phase 2 fix set, targeting repo-root docs/CLAUDE_CODE_INSTALL.md.

Phase 1 classified grep found a new boundary-owned dead-command-surface site not in the plan's Boundary Register: architecture/handoff-schema.md:705 ('normal /research, /plan, /implement invocation') inside the handoff-schema.md territory owned by records 378/428/450. Classified boundary-deferral-NEW and left untouched rather than silently fixed, per Phase 1's reconciliation instruction.

reference/standards/agent-frontmatter-standard.md:352-354 carry 3 broken relative links of their own. The file is excluded from file_scope entirely (record 431), so these cannot be fixed; recorded as a second, file-scope-driven exclusion class for the relative-link resolver alongside the documented CLAUDE.md exclusion.

Plan's Phase 2 Tier Justification named 'verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 <source_dir>' (TARGET=agent-system/extensions/core) as the covering check, but verify-deploy.sh requires TARGET/.claude to exist and the source dir has no .claude/ subdirectory -- it errors 'no deploy tree'. Using TARGET=repo root (/home/benjamin/.config/nvim, which has the deployed .claude/ and is itself the source-store repo) runs gates 3 and 4 successfully (doc-lint, task-reference lint, both PASS). Used repo-root form for this and all subsequent --only-gate 3,4 checks in this task.

Phase 5's task claimed guides/user-guide.md's Options table 'has already drifted (it omits --allow-scope-collision)', but at implementation time the table already carried that row. The plan's drift hypothesis was stale; reduced the table to a short subset plus a pointer regardless, per the task's primary instruction.

Phase 5's task named component-selection.md:~239-244 a 'second three-layer rendering' to reduce. At implementation time this is a File Location Reference directory tree (where component files live on disk), not a duplicate explanation of layer responsibilities -- it restates no prose from system-overview.md. Narrowed Phase 5's edit to the ~7-18 preamble only; left ~239-244 untouched as non-duplicative, unique content.

Phase 5's Scope Hypothesis instructed re-reading merge-sources/claudemd.md's Command Reference table before leaving it unchanged. Confirmed at Phase 6: the table is already minimal (no /research/plan/implement rows), already points into orchestrate-state-machine.md for forcing-flag/cycle-budget semantics, matching the Authority Decisions table's 'no change needed' call exactly.

Phase 7's redeploy via deploy-headless.sh landed the files but returned RESULT=landed_verify_red: the internal fast-gate check's gate 18 (lint-task-lookup-adoption.sh) failed with 5 hand-rolled jq task-lookup violations, all inside agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/test-state-write-concurrency.sh. Confirmed 100% pre-existing and unrelated to this task via empty git diff across all 6 of this task's phase commits, and the file's last touching commit (88a2722f7, 2026-11-03 18:19:28) predates this dispatch's start (2026-11-03 21:42:34). Closed Phase 7 as [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] with a full Reasoned Exclusions record. Recommend a follow-up task to fix test-state-write-concurrency.sh's hand-rolled jq shapes via the shared task-lookup helper.
